opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 1,317 vs price 470 - margin of safety 64.3%

opportunities.point: India's gelatin market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 2 to 3% annually over the next few years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The global economy is expected to grow at a pace of 3 to 3.5 percent during 2024 and 2025.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The Global economy to continue growing at 3 to 3.5 percent during 2024 and 2025, at the same pace as in 2023." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant at its factory.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Demand for gelatin is being driven by increasing consumer awareness of health benefits like joint health and skin elasticity.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The demand for medicines is expected to rise due to the rapid growth of the global ageing population.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: Gelatine sales volume decreased by 5% during the year.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the main raw material, is a significant concern for the company.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Low-cost industrial grade gelatin from China is being imported and sold as human consumption grade, impacting the market.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in..." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary barrier to market growth.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Jun) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S29/W18/O28/T12), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 58 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
